visual_hierarchy_principles: Establish a single, unmistakable hero element through disproportionate scale, central or rule-of-thirds placement, and isolation via negative space. Guide the eye with a clear primary-to-secondary-to-tertiary scale cascade, using spatial grouping to imply narrative flow without rigid grids. Secondary elements should support but never compete, achieved through reduced size, lower contrast, or peripheral positioning.
typography_craft_rules: Deploy extreme scale contrast between headline and sub-callout (minimum 3:1 ratio) to create instant visual entry. Use weight contrast (e.g., bold headline, regular/light sub-text) rather than style mixing for cohesion. Maintain generous kerning and line spacing for legibility at all sizes. Align text blocks to a consistent baseline grid or optical center to reinforce structure. Separate headline from sub-callout with at least 1.5x line-height whitespace to prevent visual merging.
color_harmony_principles: Anchor the composition with a dominant tonal field (60-70% coverage) that sets emotional temperature. Introduce a secondary hue family (20-30%) for structural differentiation without vibrancy clash. Reserve a high-contrast accent (5-10%) exclusively for the hero focal point and critical calls-to-action. Balance warm/cool relationships to create depth; ensure all tones share a common undertone or saturation ceiling for unity. Use value contrast (light vs dark) as the primary readability engine, not hue contrast alone.
lighting_and_depth_principles: Sculpt form with a key-light direction consistent across all elements to unify disparate modules. Employ soft, graduated shadows to lift the hero element off the background plane, creating a sense of physical presence. Use negative space not as emptiness but as a luminous field that frames and amplifies the subject. Layer depth through atmospheric perspective: reduce contrast, saturation, and detail in recessive zones. Avoid flat illumination; a subtle rim or fill light on edges separates forms and adds luxury tactility.
